definition.name: NXabsorption_edge
definition.doc: An absorption edge is a sharp discontinuity in the X-ray absorption spectrum of an atom that occurs when the incident photon energy reaches the threshold energy for exciting the atom from its neutral ground state to a core-vacancy state.

field.name: name
field.doc:
Name of the absorption edge using `IUPAC notation`_ (e.g., ``K``, ``L2``, ``M5``), which identifies the core-vacancy state of the atom.
Correspondence between IUPAC notation and electron configuration, expressed as vacancy notation (superscript :math:`-1`):
.. list-table:: :header-rows: 1
* - IUPAC - Electron configuration * - K - :math:`1s^{-1}` * - L1 - :math:`2s^{-1}` * - L2 - :math:`2p_{1/2}^{-1}` * - L3 - :math:`2p_{3/2}^{-1}` * - M1 - :math:`3s^{-1}` * - M2 - :math:`3p_{1/2}^{-1}` * - M3 - :math:`3p_{3/2}^{-1}` * - M4 - :math:`3d_{3/2}^{-1}` * - M5 - :math:`3d_{5/2}^{-1}` * - N1 - :math:`4s^{-1}` * - N2 - :math:`4p_{1/2}^{-1}` * - N3 - :math:`4p_{3/2}^{-1}` * - N4 - :math:`4d_{3/2}^{-1}` * - N5 - :math:`4d_{5/2}^{-1}` * - N6 - :math:`4f_{5/2}^{-1}` * - N7 - :math:`4f_{7/2}^{-1}` * - O1 - :math:`5s^{-1}` * - O2 - :math:`5p_{1/2}^{-1}` * - O3 - :math:`5p_{3/2}^{-1}` * - O4 - :math:`5d_{3/2}^{-1}` * - O5 - :math:`5d_{5/2}^{-1}` * - O6 - :math:`5f_{5/2}^{-1}` * - O7 - :math:`5f_{7/2}^{-1}` * - P1 - :math:`6s^{-1}` * - P2 - :math:`6p_{1/2}^{-1}` * - P3 - :math:`6p_{3/2}^{-1}` * - P4 - :math:`6d_{3/2}^{-1}` * - P5 - :math:`6d_{5/2}^{-1}`
Per IUPAC, subscripts may be dropped when unknown or irrelevant. When two spin-orbit split levels are not distinguished, they may be written together (e.g. ``L2,3``).
.. _IUPAC notation: https://doi.org/10.1002/xrs.1300200308

group.name: atom
group.doc: The atom whose core electron is excited at this absorption edge.
